basic_details.job_title: CUH Lab Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.job_location: Mahendergarh, Haryana (with travel to Arunachal Pradesh as required)

important_dates.interview_date: 16 October 2026 at 10:00 am (Room No 323, Academic Block-1, Central University of Haryana, Jant-Pali, Mahendergarh, Haryana-123031)

age_limit.details: Age limit for the post is as per DBT/GOI rules. | Not specified in the notification.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | lab assistant: Candidate must have a Bachelor’s degree (with minimum 55% marks) in Microbiology or Life Sciences (Should have zoology/ botany as subjects). Preference will be given to candidates having post-graduation in life sciences/microbiology.

salary_details.lab assistant: Rs. 21,800/- per month (As per norms of funding agency)
salary_details.details: No T.A/D.A or any other allowances will be paid for attending the interview.

selection_process: The selection process consists of an interview.
how_to_apply: Prepare the application on plain paper along with a detailed CV following the provided format (Annexure 1).
Compile the cover letter, CV, and all required details into a single PDF file.
Ensure the subject line of the email clearly mentions “Application for the post of Project Personnel (Lab Assistant) under DBT Project”.
Send the single PDF file via email to [email protected] on or before 13 October 2026.
Keep self-attested copies of all relevant documents and a passport size photograph ready to bring at the time of the interview.
important_instructions: The above post is purely temporary for the sanctioned project and duration (2.5 years or co-terminus with the project). No T.A/D.A or any other allowances will be paid for attending the interview. Position may be withdrawn at any time in case of any misconduct, unsatisfactory research work, or if applicant is found ineligible later. The rules and regulations of CUH and/or the funding agency will be applicable on the selected candidate. Canvassing in any form will lead to the disqualification of the candidate. The candidate may have to travel to Arunachal Pradesh multiple times to collect samples. The candidate may have to devote time in the lab beyond office hours to complete the task.
